_doc: Methodology copy for scatter filter tabs — opened in the entity drawer on Layer / Quadrant chip click.

exposed.body: Exposure is running ahead of preparedness — high non-firm intensity, concentration, or trigger gap without the data, products, capital and modelling to carry it. Cut rule: exposure at or above the universe median and preparedness below. Losses concentrate here when curtailment bites and wordings still read like physical damage.

earning_it.body: Carrying real non-firm risk with the balance sheet, products and register-backed measurement to match. Cut rule: both axes at or above the universe median. The quadrant the market should reward — but only if the measured share on the underlying sub-factors is honest.

whitespace.body: Preparedness exceeds exposure — rated paper, product fit and underwriting depth exist, but the non-firm book has not yet caught up. Cut rule: exposure below median, preparedness at or above. The placement opportunity if wordings and triggers close the gap.

sidelined.body: Neither materially exposed nor yet prepared to underwrite non-firm power risk. Cut rule: both axes below the universe median. Often early-stage MGAs, generalist carriers, or assets still on firm connections — the market is forming around them.

1.title: Carriers & syndicates
1.body: Balance-sheet writers — composite insurers and Lloyd's syndicates. Exposure is energy and data-centre premium concentration from segmental filings; preparedness is capital (FSR/SCR), product breadth, curtailment pricing and aggregation modelling.

2.title: MGAs & brokers
2.body: Price and place without mostly carrying the balance sheet. Exposure is non-firm risk routed through facilities and delegated authority; preparedness is the products they can structure and the expertise to match trigger to peril.

3.title: Energy & data-centre assets
3.body: Originate the peril — hyperscale campuses, batteries, flexible industrial load. Exposure is flexible-connection share and NESO Gate / DNO ECR queue position; preparedness is backup power, monitoring and contractual firmness.
3.role: Examples: data centres, batteries on Gate-1 / curtailable connections
